skill.upgrade.description:
Strengthen every manual click. 
Normal income rises from +{current} to +{next} hits.
skill.plus.description: Boost the income gained per Click Growth level, including levels you already own. Normal clicks rise from +{current} to +{next} hit, and future Click Growth upgrades benefit too.
skill.lucky.description:
Give manual clicks a chance to earn more. 
Each click rolls independently, with a {chance}% chance of ×{multiplier}.
skill.chance.description: Raise the base chance of a lucky click from {current}% to {next}%, up to 50%. Helpers with their luck skill also benefit. Fortune further adjusts the effective chance.
skill.multiplier.description: Increase the reward multiplier when luck triggers: ×{current} → ×{next}.
skill.jackpot.description: After unlocking, every 20th manual click earns ×{multiplier}, stacking with lucky hits and combos.
skill.frequency.description: Trigger Big Hits more often: reduce the interval from every {current} to every {next} manual clicks, down to 10.
skill.jackpot-power.description: Increase the reward when a Big Hit triggers: ×{current} → ×{next}, adding 2 to the multiplier per level.
skill.helper-a.description: Unlock Helper A to click for you automatically. It earns +{amount} hit every {interval} seconds. Unlock it once, then upgrade its Power and Speed separately.
skill.helper-a-power.description: Raise Helper A’s base income per automatic click from +{current} to +{next} hit, with +{step} per level.
skill.helper-a-speed.description: Shorten Helper A’s automatic click interval from {current} to {next} seconds, down to 0.5 seconds. Normal income rises from {rate} to {nextRate} hit/s.
skill.helper-a-lucky.description: Let Helper A trigger lucky hits too. Each click rolls independently, using your effective lucky chance of {chance}% and ×{multiplier} multiplier.
skill.helper-b.description: Unlock Helper B to click for you automatically. It earns +{amount} hit every {interval} seconds.
skill.helper-b-power.description: Raise Helper B’s base income per automatic click from +{current} to +{next} hit, with +{step} per level.
skill.helper-b-speed.description: Shorten Helper B’s automatic click interval from {current} to {next} seconds, down to 0.5 seconds.
skill.helper-b-lucky.description: Let Helper B trigger lucky hits too. Each click rolls independently, using your effective lucky chance of {chance}% and ×{multiplier} multiplier.
skill.combo-a.description: Each manual click has an independent 1% chance of ×{multiplier} (Helper A’s normal click income). Increases with A’s Power and stacks with lucky hits, Big Hits and Combo B.
skill.combo-b.description: Each manual click has an independent 1% chance of ×{multiplier} (Helper B’s normal click income).
skill.fortune.description: Starts at 50, capped at 100. Every 3 manual clicks: 50% chance of +5 or −5. Effective lucky chance = base chance + (Fortune − 50)/2 percentage points; 25%–75% at a 50% base chance.
skill.emperor.description: At 100 Fortune, add 6 to base manual income before lucky, Big Hit and combo multipliers. Fortune updates after that click is resolved. This bonus affects manual clicks, not helpers’ base income.
skill.pity.description: After unlocking, accumulate 100 manual clicks while Fortune is below 50: updates then have a 50% chance of +5 or −2. The counter resets when Fortune reaches 50 or more.
skill.jackpot.requirement: Requires Click Growth Lv.5 and Lucky Chance Lv.5
skill.helper-b.requirement: Requires 10000 total hit earned and Helper A Power Lv.4
skill.helper-a-power.requirement: Requires Helper A and Click Growth Lv.7
skill.helper-b-power.requirement: Requires Helper B and Click Growth Lv.7
skill.helper-a-lucky.requirement: Requires Helper A, Lucky Chance Lv.5 and 2000 total hit earned
skill.helper-b-lucky.requirement: Requires Helper B, Lucky Chance Lv.5 and 20000 total hit earned
skill.combo-a.requirement: Requires Helper A Power Lv.2 and 10000 total hit earned
skill.combo-b.requirement: Requires Combo A and Helper B Power Lv.2

confirm.reset.title: Reset game progress?
confirm.reset.body: This clears your current and total hit, upgrades and helpers. Sound settings are kept. Select Cancel or press Esc to return.

save.read_error: Your browser cannot read the save right now. You can keep playing, but progress may not be kept. Try saving again.
save.backup_error: Your old progress was restored, but backup failed. The original save was kept. Retrying will save progress in the new format.
save.invalid: The save is damaged or incompatible, so a new game has started. The old save has not been overwritten. Select “Save current progress” to replace it.
save.write_error: Could not save current progress. Reloading may restore an older save or start a new game. You can keep playing and retry saving.
audio.unavailable: Sound is unavailable. Keep playing or use the sound button to retry.

legacy.lucky_description: Unlock for 50 hit after Click Growth Lv.2. Grants Lucky Chance Lv.1 (10%) and a base ×2 lucky multiplier. Helpers need their own luck skills to inherit it.
legacy.confirm_body: This clears your current and total hit, upgrades and helpers. Sound settings are kept.
